lessons.perfect-3: cs-only lesson (profile cs.md §8 add, §4.1): «Předpřítomný, nebo minulý čas? Jeden český čas, dva anglické» — Present Perfect vs Past Simple in both directions, the best-measured Czech error (Gráf 2017: Present Perfect involved in 73% of tense-choice errors, missing 58 times and wrongly used 37 times in 50 advanced speakers). Three Czech-to-English decisions: Czech present + duration → Present Perfect (I've lived here for five years); Czech past + result now → Present Perfect (I've lost my keys, My bike has been stolen); Czech past + finished time → Past Simple whatever the 'trigger' word (I saw it on my birthday, I visited Lisbon last summer, We met in 2019); one note on American usage (I just ate = I've just eaten, both accepted). ko-en has no such lesson; the English side (examples, 3-question check, 15-item practice set) is new, written for cs. mc and fill items carry the tense point alone; 3 of 3 order items and 3 of 4 type items are double hinges (tense + article or plural) so the standing rule holds. Placed after perfect-2 via profile.json lessonOrder.after; deck «Představování» (deck 2, as perfect-2).
